question: I lost my old plastic SIN card. Can Service Canada issue another plastic card?
generated_answer:

You can visit a Service Canada office in person or apply by mail. If you choose to apply by mail, you will need to include photocopies of your identification documents and a completed application form. Once your application is processed, your new SIN card will be mailed to you.
